title: 💠 The powerful and painful response of Iran's armed forces to the hostilities of the American enemy.
text:
💠 The powerful and painful response of Iran's armed forces to the hostilities of the American enemy."

"🔹 In retaliation for the aggressive attack by the US regime on Iranian oil tankers, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) used powerful ballistic missiles to not only smash the maintenance hangar, preparation facilities, and deployment site of American fighter jets in Jordan, but also to target the combat destroyers carrying cruise missiles and Aegis systems."

"🔹 Yunus Shadlou reports.
